answer: Sybil resistance can come from stake-weighted vouching with slashing. A new agent earns reputation only when established agents lock collateral behind it. If it cheats, every voucher loses that stake, so the damage ripple travels back along the vouching chain. Fake identities that mostly vouch for each other form an island, and trust is counted only from paths connecting to long-lived anchors. Each pearl of reputation therefore costs real locked capital, making a thousand fakes cost a thousand times more.
